criteria.priority_notes: Topic scope emphasises research novelty and quality: advanced AI agent architectures, novel planning and reasoning mechanisms, multi-agent frameworks, and multimodal reasoning capabilities. All proposals must include qualitative and quantitative KPIs and benchmarking mechanisms as indicators of scientific rigour. Numeric weight not stated in topic-specific documents; standard Horizon Europe RIA weighting applies per General Annexes.
criteria.assumption_note: Evaluation criterion 'Excellence' is the standard Horizon Europe RIA evaluation criterion defined in the General Annexes (Tier 1). It is not named or weighted in the topic-specific source documents. Priority notes are derived from scope content identifying research quality indicators explicitly required of proposals (KPIs, benchmarking, novel AI architectures). Criterion name and any numeric weight must be confirmed against Tier 2A evaluation form schema and Tier 1 General Annexes.

criteria.criterion_name: Quality and Efficiency of the Implementation
criteria.priority_notes: Evaluates the coherence and effectiveness of the work plan, quality and appropriateness of the management structure and procedures, and quality of the proposed supervision, training and career development conditions offered to the researcher. Minimum threshold score and numeric weight are defined in Annex D.

criteria.priority_notes: Topic requires contribution to the Apply AI Strategy; portfolio coverage exception guarantees awards to at least one proposal per sector (healthcare, advanced manufacturing, in-vehicle autonomous driving) provided evaluation thresholds are met, indicating sector-specific impact breadth is an explicit award-level priority. Results must feed the AI-on-demand platform, AI Factories, Data Labs, Testing and Experiment Facilities, and EDIHs, evidencing expected societal and economic impact pathways.
criteria.inference_note: Evaluation criterion 'Impact' is the standard Horizon Europe RIA criterion and is not named as such in the topic-specific documents. The portfolio coverage exception (HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02.json, procedure_exceptions) explicitly prioritises sector-specific impact in healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and autonomous driving; the scope mandates Apply AI Strategy contribution and AI ecosystem infrastructure linkage. Treating Impact as an evaluative priority is logically derivable from these confirmed source provisions taken together. Numeric weight must be confirmed against Tier 2A evaluation form schema and Tier 1 General Annexes.

criteria.priority_notes: Proposals must demonstrate structured implementation through mandatory KPI and benchmarking frameworks, cohesion activity allocations with ADRA and GenAI4EU Hub, and linkage to AI Factories and Data Labs infrastructure. These are explicit implementation requirements stated in the scope text.
